rows.detail: Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Meeting runs 8–9 December; after hotter-than-expected October core inflation (25 Nov), markets fully price a quarter-point rise, the main pressure on silver and gold lately.
rows.affects: Silver and gold funds (about 30% of the portfolio)

rows.detail: Next reading of the Fed's preferred gauge, due after the December Fed meeting.
